_what: Dictionaries a settle upload may be compressed against (parts/device-copy/do-work/frame-compression.mjs). A dictionary is a sample of the JSON a settle carries: its identity is the BLAKE3 hash of its UTF-8 bytes, named by the sender in the frame header and found here by the receiver, so a dictionary is never trusted by name and an unknown one is refused. To change a dictionary, add a new row and leave the old one: a device that opened its page before the change still sends the old one. `content_type`, `dictionary_header` and `size_header` name the three things a compressed frame carries; `size_header` is the exact byte count of the text once expanded and a frame without it is refused. `max_compressed_bytes` caps what is read of a frame before expanding it; the expanded cap is the caller's own limit on that request. `min_bytes_to_compress`: a text shorter than this is sent as it is.

dictionaries.note: record envelopes and the properties most record kinds carry (src/record-model.json)
